sections.kicker: Prepared for La Rebelde by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site and your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: La Rebelde wrote its position in a caption. The bio and the site have not caught up.
sections.keep: The Winter Market art: plum, thin gold lines and pink letters. It looks like nobody else's.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet

pins.quote: the hottest Home Décor Boutique in town
pins.what: Your bio calls La Rebelde the hottest home décor boutique in town.
pins.why: Every shop in every town says this about itself. It does not say what a rebel home is.
pins.how: Open the bio with the rebel idea you already wrote in a caption, and let the boutique line follow.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: A shopper who cannot tell what makes La Rebelde different measures it against the nearest showroom.

pins.quote: Because a home should feel like YOU, not a showroom.
pins.what: One caption states the real position of La Rebelde.
pins.why: Collected, loud and a little unexpected: this answers why La Rebelde and not the polished showroom next door.
pins.how: Make this line the first thing the bio and the site say.
pins.label: Your caption
pins.cost: The best line the brand owns sits inside one post that scrolls away.

pins.area: The site opens on a pink gift card over a rug market photo
pins.what: The site's first screen is a pink gift card, in a different voice from your Instagram.
pins.why: The grid is plum, leopard and rugs. The site's first screen shows none of that world.
pins.how: Open the site on the rebel world from the grid and let the gift card sit lower.
pins.label: Your site
pins.cost: Someone who arrives from Instagram feels they landed in a different shop.

sections.intro: You asked for a look at La Rebelde. I spent some time on your site and your Instagram. Three things stood out.
